## Context
Triggered `.github/workflows/release-macos-app.yml` for tag `v1.4.0` on 2026-02-05. The run failed during **Import certificate** because required GitHub secrets were empty.

Failure run:
- https://github.com/hack-dance/hack/actions/runs/21730076534

Key log detail:
- `CERTIFICATE_P12:` and `CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD:` were blank in the workflow environment
- `security: SecKeychainItemImport: One or more parameters passed to a function were not valid.`

## Goals
1. Configure required repo secrets:
   - `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12`
   - `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`
   - `APPLE_ID`
   - `APPLE_ID_PASSWORD`
   - `APPLE_TEAM_ID`
2. Re-run `Release macOS App` for `v1.4.0`.
3. Verify DMG/ZIP assets upload to the `v1.4.0` release.

## Notes
- Depends on broader CI automation ticket `T-00076`.
- CLI release workflow was successfully triggered separately for `v1.4.0`.

## Links
- Workflow file: `.github/workflows/release-macos-app.yml`
- Failed run: https://github.com/hack-dance/hack/actions/runs/21730076534
- Related ticket: T-00076
payload.title: Release v1.4.0: unblock macOS app workflow secrets
macOS app: stamp release version into Info.plist + artifact names

payload.body:
## Context
Releases currently upload macOS artifacts named `HackDesktop-1.0-macOS.{dmg,zip}` even when the CLI tag is `v1.x.y`.

Root cause: `xcodegen generate` overwrites `apps/macos/App/Info.plist` and hardcodes `CFBundleShortVersionString=1.0` and `CFBundleVersion=1`, so the built app always reports `1.0`.

## Goals
- Ensure the built app version matches release version (`MARKETING_VERSION` / tag `v${version}`).
- Ensure uploaded artifact names include the real version (e.g. `HackDesktop-1.4.3-macOS.dmg`).
- Prefer a repo-level fix (xcodegen config) over CI-only patching.

## Notes
- Candidate fixes:
  - Update `apps/macos/project.yml` `targets.HackDesktop.info` to set `CFBundleShortVersionString` / `CFBundleVersion` via `properties`.
  - Or patch the generated `App/Info.plist` after `xcodegen generate` and before `xcodebuild` in `.github/workflows/release-macos-app.yml`.

## Links
- `.github/workflows/release-macos-app.yml`
- `apps/macos/project.yml`
- `apps/macos/App/Info.plist`

## Context
GitHub reports 4 vulnerabilities on `main` (2 high, 2 moderate) after pushes on 2026-02-05.

## Goals
- Review Dependabot alerts and identify impacted packages.
- Upgrade dependencies (and `bun.lock`) to patched versions.
- Run `bun test` + `bun run typecheck`.

## Links
- Dependabot alerts: https://github.com/hack-dance/hack/security/dependabot
payload.title: Deps: address Dependabot vulnerabilities
